players.kick.heading: Kick {name} from {world}?
players.kick.will_disconnect: Disconnect {name} now. They can join again at once.
players.kick.gone: {name} is no longer in the game, so there is no one to kick.
players.ban.heading: Ban {name} from {world}?
players.ban.will_disconnect: Disconnect {name} now, if they are in the game.
players.ban.will_list: Add {name} to the ban list, so they cannot join again until unbanned. The ban list is on the world's Settings tab.
players.ban.no_snapshot: Take no snapshot. The game records the ban in its own ban list.
players.reason.label: Reason
players.reason.hint: Optional. {name} sees it. One line, up to {max} characters.
players.done.demoted: {name} is no longer an admin of {world}.
players.done.whitelist_removed: {name} is no longer on the whitelist of {world}.
players.undo.whitelist_add: Undo: add {name} to the whitelist again
players.error.name: This is not a usable player name. A name can be up to {max} bytes and cannot contain spaces, control characters or invisible characters.
players.error.reason: The reason must be one line of at most {max} characters.
players.error.refused: The game of {world} did not make the change to {name}. It answered:
players.error.rcon: The game of {world} did not answer over RCON, so Foreman cannot tell whether the change to {name} was made. Check the list, then try again.
players.error.not_running: The server of {world} is not running, so nothing can be sent to the game.
players.error.whitelist_off: The server of {world} was started with the whitelist switch off, so the game would not keep this change. Edit the whitelist on the Settings tab instead.
players.error.failed: The change could not be sent to the game of {world}. Try again.
